assessments.reason: Shortening the installation deadline from sixty to thirty days leaves Operator less time, raising the risk of a missed deadline and stipulated assessments: "within thirty days after the effective date".
assessments.quote: within thirty days after the effective date

assessments.reason: Monthly reporting instead of quarterly triples the reporting burden and certification exposure: "every calendar month for one year".
assessments.quote: every calendar month for one year

counter.find: every calendar month for one year
counter.replace: every calendar quarter for one year

assessments.reason: Longer notice before inspections gives Operator more preparation time: "upon ten business days' written notice".
assessments.quote: upon ten business days' written notice

assessments.reason: The confidentiality paragraph is only moved to Section 9 with identical text, so protection is unchanged: "designated confidential by Operator".
The penalty is halved, reducing Operator's payment: "$24,000 within thirty days".
The daily stipulated assessment quadruples, increasing exposure for missed deadlines, which are more likely given the shorter deadline: "$1,000 per day".
Replacing "keep" with "retain" is stylistic and has no substantive effect: "shall retain a complete copy".
"becomes effective" versus "takes effect" is a wording change only, with the same timing on signature: "becomes effective when both authorized representatives sign it".
assessments.quote: becomes effective when both authorized representatives sign it
